data.one_liner: Flutter web plugin that clears session storage and reloads the page when app version changes.
data.what_it_does: Provides a single method to compare a supplied version string with one stored in the browser's session storage. If they differ, it clears the session storage and forces a page reload, ensuring users see the latest web app version.
use_when: You need to guarantee users load the newest version of a Flutter web app after a deployment
You want to automatically clear stale session data on version change without manual user action
avoid_when: The app runs on mobile or desktop platforms
You need to preserve session data across version updates
You require more granular cache control beyond session storage
strengths: Very small and easy to integrate
Works on HTTPS as well as localhost
No native code or platform-specific setup
weaknesses: Clears only session storage, not other caches

alternatives.name: flutter_cache_manager
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides broader cache management for files and assets, useful if you need more than just session storage clearing
